statement: For the RESOCA rule-115 global map F and centered finite initial pair (u,c^(k)) defined in source.md and problem.md, the least positive period for k=2i is P(2i)=(2*4^(2i+2)-7*4^(i+1)+5)/3 for every integer i>=0, including P(0)=3.
contribution: A computer-assisted all-length proof.  At times divisible by three, an exact radius-two block transducer decouples the orbit into left and right path-language permutations.  A new finite-state induction identifies each permutation with the cyclic colexicographic successor on every admissible path, proving least factor periods A_i=(4^(i+1)-1)/3 and B_i=(2*4^(i+1)-5)/3.  Their coprimality and the exact period-three background then give the asserted least F-period, not only a return time.
